verdict.rationale: Docs confirm native integrations for Jira and Linear, including remote delegation where issues can be assigned to Factory or @Factory mentioned to have Droid investigate/implement work (factory-docs-36, factory-docs-37), plus session syncing with Jira/Linear (factory-docs-26). However, ClickUp and Monday.com are never mentioned anywhere in the evidence, so full ticket-tracker coverage as named in the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: ClickUp support, Monday.com support, and independent/hands-on verification of the Jira/Linear workflows.
